description: Qubo Dashcam Trio was launched in India recently. The new three-channel dash camera is currently listed on the company’s website for under Rs. 11,000, a highly competitive price. Various Chinese players, like the 70mai, dominate this price segment. Qubo’s Dashcam Trio slightly undercuts its competition. There are various three-channel dash cameras on the market. However, 2K resolution units are too cheap, and three-channel models are too expensive. Qubo’s offering fills this particular gap.
title: Qubo Dashcam Trio Review: Is This 3-Channel Setup Worth the Price?

description: New research suggests Saturn’s largest moon Titan and its iconic rings may share a violent origin. Simulations indicate Titan formed after a massive collision between two moons about 100 to 200 million years ago, resurfacing Titan and altering its orbit. The resulting instability likely shattered smaller moons, sending icy debris inward to create Saturn’s surprisingly young rings. Scientists say future missions could uncover evidence confirming this dramatic chapter in Saturn’s history.
title: Researchers Suggest Saturn's Titan Moon Formed in a Single High-Energy Impact Event

description: Google has announced America-India Connect, a collaborative infrastructure initiative anchored by Google's five-year $15 billion AI infrastructure investment in India. With this, the company aims to establish a new international subsea gateway in Visakhapatnam. It will create three new subsea paths connecting India to Singapore, South Africa, and Australia, and four strategic fibre-optic routes linking the US, India, and multiple locations across the Southern Hemisphere.
title: AI Impact Summit: Google Announces Plans to Build Three New Subsea Cables From India, Four Fiber-Optic Routes

description: Avowed is now available on PS5 a year after its release on PC and Xbox Series S/X, Microsoft and Obsidian Entertainment have announced. The game's PS5 version arrives alongside a major 2.0 patch that adds new features like photo mode, new playable species, and new game plus mode.
title: Avowed Gets PS5 Release Alongside Major Anniversary Update With New Features

description: One of the most anticipated Telugu horror films, Eesha, finally has an OTT release date. Written and directed by Manne Srinivas, this psychological horror-thriller centers on four friends who embark on a mission to debunk superstitions. After completing a successful theatrical run, this film will drop on February 20, 2026, exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
title: Eesha OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Hebah Patel and Thrigun Starrer Online?

description: Google Pixel 10a has been launched in India. The smartphone will go on sale in the country at 9pm local time today via Flipkart and the Google India online store. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in India on March 6 in Lavender, Obsidian, Fog, and Berry colour options. The new Pixel 10a is backed by a 5,100mAh battery. It features 30W wired and wireless charging support. It is powered by Google's Tensor G4 chipset, along with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. It carries a dual rear camera setup.
title: Google Pixel 10a Launched in India With 5,100mAh Battery, 48-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI announced on Wednesday that it will collaborate with multiple higher education institutions in India to provide help and support to students in the country. The first cohort of institutes that the company will collaborate with will include the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad, the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) New Delhi, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES), and Pearl Academy.
title: OpenAI Announces Collaboration With IITs, IIMs and More Institutes at AI Impact Summit

description: Here we have listed the best seven laser printers available in India right now for students and professionals. The list contains popular models from brands such as HP, Canon, Brother and more. You can compare prices and specifications before making the final decision. Some models support duplex (two-sided) printing and are compatible with different devices, and offer different connectivity options.
title: Top 7 Laser Printers for Students and Professionals in 2026

description: Veerappan The Bandit King is an upcoming thriller series that reflects on the life of the notorious and dangerous Veerappan. Directed by AMR Ramesh, the series stars Kishore in the lead role and explores the outlaw's life, covering everything from his childhood to the end of his reign of terror. The first season will premiere with six episodes exclusively on the Waves OTT platform starting February 27, 2026. The series will be available to stream in Kannada, Tamil, and Hindi.
title: Veerappan The Bandit King Now Set for OTT Release on Waves OTT: What You Need to Know

description: Formerly known as Hey Bhagawan, Suhas's upcoming Telugu family drama has been retitled Hey Balwanth. A complete family entertainer, the movie revolves around a young man and his father's unusual business. According to reports, ZEE5 has acquired the digital streaming rights for Hey Balwanth for a significant price following its theatrical run. The film is expected to premiere on the platform during the second week of March 2026.
title: Hey Balwanth Reportedly Locks Digital Streaming Partner: What You Need to Know About Suhas and Shivani Nagaram Starrer

description: Hot Spot 2 Much is about to wrap up its theatrical run and make its way to OTT platforms. A spiritual sequel to the 2024 film Hot Spot, the movie was written and directed by Vignesh Karthick. It delivers an intense social drama with a gripping narrative structured into three distinct stories. Hot Spot 2 Much is set for a multi-streamer release and will be available on Amazon Prime Video, Aha, and Lionsgate Play starting February 20, 2026.
title: Hot Spot 2 Much to Stream on OTT Soon: What to Know About Vignesh Karthick’s Social Satire

description: Directed by Uday Mahesh, Lucky The Superstar is an upcoming Tamil comedy-drama film set to debut soon on digital screens, offering a blend of humor and entertainment. The plot is light-hearted and revolves around a lost puppy whose transformative impact on people's lives makes him the heart of the movie. This film drops on February 20, 2026, exclusively on JioHotstar.
title: Lucky The Superstar Set for Direct-to-OTT Release: Details About This G.V. Prakash Kumar, Anaswara Rajan Starrer

description: ESA’s CHEOPS mission has uncovered a surprising rocky planet at the outer edge of the LHS 1903 system. Located 116 light-years away, the discovery defies expectations that outer planets are gas giants. Scientists say the finding offers rare evidence that planets can form in gas-depleted environments, challenging current planetary formation models.
title: Scientists Discover High-Density Rocky Planet in LHS 1903 System That Defies Conventional Formation Models

description: Physicists have proposed a new concept called spacetime quasicrystals, orderly structures that never repeat but exist across space and time. If proven, they could help explain the universe’s deep structure, quantum gravity, and hidden dimensions, while preserving key laws of relativity even at extremely small scales.
title: Scientists Explore How Non-Repeating Quasicrystal Patterns Could Solve the Mystery of Quantum Gravity

description: The Black Phone 2 is a supernatural horror film and the sequel to the 2021 hit The Black Phone. The movie features the return of the psychic Gwen and Ethan Hawke as the terrifying antagonist. Following the success of the first two installments, a third film is reportedly already in development. You can watch Black Phone 2 online on JioHotstar from February 28, 2026 onwards. Viewers will require a subscription to the streaming service to watch it online.
title: The Black Phone 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Ethan Hawke’s Horror Sequel Online?

description: Nothing has released an awareness video via various social media platforms to warn customers that the Indian market has been flooded with counterfeit Nothing and CMF products. Akis Evangelidis, Co-Founder and President of Nothing India, said in the video that the London-based tech firm is working with law enforcement agencies to "identify and dismantle counterfeit supply chains” in the country. He claimed that the Delhi Police have seized more than 1,100 counterfeit charging adapters and true wireless stereo (TWS) with Nothing and CMF branding.
title: Nothing Warns Customers About Counterfeit Accessories as Delhi Police Seize Fake Nothing, CMF Devices

description: Scientists have detected a possible ultra-fast pulsar spinning every 8.19 milliseconds near the Milky Way’s central black hole. If confirmed, this rare object could act as a precise cosmic clock, helping researchers study how gravity behaves in extreme environments and offering a powerful new way to test Einstein’s theory of general relativity near a supermassive black hole.
title: Scientists Spot Ultra-Fast Pulsar Near Milky Way’s Supermassive Black Hole

description: Microsoft has announced Game Pass wave 2 lineup for February. The game subscription service will soon add Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, EA Sports College Football 26, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Complete Edition, among other games. Ubisoft's Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora is now available on Game Pass, as well.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and College Football 26 Coming to Xbox Game Pass

description: Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro prices in Europe have surfaced online, along with the specifications and features of the two upcoming smartphones. Recently, the London-based tech firm confirmed that the Nothing Phone 4a series will be launched in India on March 5 at 4pm local time. The handsets are confirmed to be available for purchase in the country via Flipkart. Nothing’s Phone 4a series is expected to be offered in pink, black, blue, silver, and white colour options. The phones will reportedly go on sale in March.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Series Leak Hints at Price, Key Specifications Weeks Ahead of March 5 Launch

description: Oppo Find X9s could launch soon as a successor to last year's Oppo Find X8s. The Oppo Find X9 series phone is likely to make its debut in global markets, including India, in the second quarter of this year. The international variant will not be identical to the model launching in China, with several differences in specifications. It is said to run on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset. It could be launched in 256GB and 512GB storage options
title: Oppo Find X9s Global Variant Specifications, Launch Timeline Leaked; Might Debut With 7,025mAh Battery

description: Samsung’s first Galaxy Unpacked event of 2026 is all set to take place on February 25, where it will unveil the next-generation Galaxy S series. Pre-reservation for the upcoming lineup, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy S26 series, has already commenced in India. The tech giant has now confirmed that early customers will be able to avail of a free storage upgrade on pre-reserving the handsets, in addition to other benefits like a daily voucher and a high exchange value lock-in.
title: Samsung Confirms Free Storage Upgrade for Galaxy S26 Series Pre-Reserve Customers in India

description: Apple is said to be developing a new wave of AI-centric hardware. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant’s lineup of artificial intelligence (AI) devices includes smart glasses, camera-equipped AirPods, and a wearable pendant device. Apple is said to be exploring new form factors that extend beyond the iPhone and Vision Pro. While the company has yet to confirm these plans, the projects are reportedly in active development, with early prototypes already being tested internally.
title: Apple Reportedly Exploring AI-Centric Wearables Beyond iPhone; Smart Glasses, AI Pendant in Development

description: Google has announced that its annual developer conference, Google I/O 2026, will take place on May 19 and May 20. The dates were revealed after users solved an online puzzle, with the “save the date” page featuring Gemini-powered minigames. The event is expected to focus heavily on artificial intelligence, with updates across Gemini, Android, Search, Chrome, Workspace, and Pixel devices. Google will likely livestream key sessions, while the in-person venue is yet to be confirmed.
title: Google I/O 2026: Sundar Pichai Confirms Conference Dates, Gemini-Powered Minigames Offer Early Preview

description: Google is reportedly developing an advanced facial recognition feature codenamed “Project Toscana”. This is said to be available on Pixel handsets and Chromebooks. The company reportedly tested this hardware with UX testers on a Pixel phone featuring a single hole-punch camera cutout and on two Chromebooks with external cameras. It is reportedly designed to work efficiently in low-light conditions. It is expected to use the infrared (IR) technology.
title: Google's 'Project Toscana' to Upgrade Face Unlock System on Pixel Phones, Chromebooks: Report

description: Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology Ashwini Vaishnaw stated on Tuesday that major digital platforms such as YouTube, Meta, X, and Netflix must function within India’s constitutional boundaries. His remarks follow the government’s recent tightening of content‑takedown norms. He spoke during an AI summit in Delhi, which is hosting senior executives from leading global AI companies along with several world leaders this week.
title: Government Tells Global Tech Platforms to Follow Constitution After Tougher Content Rules

description: Mihup.ai, an Indian artificial intelligence (AI) company, announced on Tuesday that it has entered into a new collaboration with the US-based chipmaker Qualcomm for its Edge Voice Intelligence stack. As part of the stack, the company's voice-based tools, built for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector, will now be capable of processing data on-device, eliminating the need to send them to a data centre. Mihup.ai claims that its on-device voice intelligence stack has been optimised for more than 12 regional languages of India.
title: India AI Impact Summit: Qualcomm, Mihup.ai to Build On-Device Voice AI Tool for BFSI Sector

description: Infinix Note 60 and Note 60 have been listed on the company’s global website ahead of their launch. The listings confirm various details about the two smartphones, including their key specifications, features, and colour options. The Infinix Note 60 Pro is confirmed to be offered in Deep Ocean Blue, Mist Titanium, Mocha Brown, Solar Orange, Torino Black, and Frost Silver colourways, while the standard model will go on sale in Fizz Blue, Midnight Black, Mocha Brown, Mist Titanium, and Rose Gold shades.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro, Note 60 Listed on Company's Website Ahead of Launch: Specifications, Features

description: Infinix Note Edge 5G was launched in India on Wednesday, a month after its debut in the global market. It arrives as the latest mid-range smartphone from the China-based original equipment manufacturer (OEM). The handset marks the debut of XOS 16, Infinix’s Android 16-based operating system (OS). The Infinix Note Edge 5G sports a 1.5K 120Hz Curved AMOLED screen and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset. It packs a 6,500mAh battery with 45W fast charging support.
title: Infinix Note Edge 5G Launched in India With 120Hz Curved AMOLED Screen, 6,500mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo Watch S has been launched in global markets with a 1.46-inch AMOLED display. It runs on a BES2800BP chipset coupled with 4GB RAM. It is claimed to deliver up to 10 days of battery life in normal use. The Oppo Watch S has an IP68-rated build, and it supports more than 100 sports modes. The wearable is launched in two colour options, and it offers a 60-Second Wellness Overview feature.
title: Oppo Watch S Launched Globally With 1.46-Inch AMOLED Display, Over 100 Sports Modes

description: The price of the ROG Xbox Ally X has reportedly been hiked in Japan. The handheld's price has gone up from JPY 139,800 ($910) to JPY 169,800 ($1,106) — a hike of JPY 30,000, or nearly $200. Asus has not announced a reason for the price hike, but it could be due to global memory and storage shortages.
title: ROG Xbox Ally X Gets Nearly $200 Price Hike in Japan Amidst Global Memory and Storage Shortages

description: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Ultra has been launched in the UK, along with the Galaxy Book 6 Pro and Galaxy Book 6. All three models are equipped with Intel’s Panther Lake CPUs. Scheduled to go on sale in the country on March 11 in a single Grey colour option, the Galaxy Book 6 lineup will be available for pre-order starting February 25. The tech giant has also announced that it plans to launch the Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Enterprise Edition later this year, in April.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Ultra, Galaxy Book 6 Pro Launched Alongside Galaxy Book 6: Price, Specifications

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is set to be launched at the Galaxy Unpacked event scheduled for next week. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a new report from South Korea suggests that a price hike now looks increasingly likely for the next-generation Galaxy S series lineup. While there are concerns among the tech giant’s mobile leadership about weakening its competitive position in the premium segment, it might not be able to absorb the additional expenses caused by increasing memory component costs.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series to Reportedly See Price Hike Amid Rising Chip Costs, Raising Competitive Concerns

description: Tecno Camon 50 Pro and Camon 50 are listed on the company website, disclosing the specifications and features. They feature 6.78-inch AMOLED displays with a 144Hz refresh rate and 1.5K resolution. Both models feature a 50-megapixel primary camera with a 1/1.56-inch sensor. They are powered by a MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate chipset and feature a 6,150mAh battery with 45W charging support.
title: Tecno Camon 50 Pro, Camon 50 Launched With MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate SoC, 6,150mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: YouTube suffered an outage in India and globally during the early hours of Wednesday. According to complaints on social media, the Google-owned video sharing platform left users unable to access it or its features on both mobile and web platforms. Over three lakh user reports were logged on a website which detects and monitors downtime activity, while YouTube itself has also issued a statement regarding the outage.
title: YouTube Down? Over 3 Lakh Users Report Outage Across the Globe on App, TV
